messages.author: Priya Nair
messages.text: I was charged $49.00 twice for March.

messages.author: Tom (HelpHub)
messages.text: Thanks Priya, I can see both charges. I will refund the duplicate today.

messages.author: Marcus Webb
messages.text: My lamp base for order HH-55901 never arrived.

messages.author: Dana (HelpHub)
messages.text: Sorry about that Marcus. I see it shipped on 2025-08-05. Let me open a trace.

messages.author: system
messages.text: Carrier trace #TR-90311 opened.

messages.author: Marcus Webb
messages.text: Any news? A week has passed.

messages.author: Dana (HelpHub)
messages.text: The carrier says it was delivered to your previous address. I have asked them to retrieve it.

messages.author: Marcus Webb
messages.text: I changed my address two days before ordering! This is your mistake.

messages.author: Dana (HelpHub)
messages.text: Checked: address change was saved 2025-08-04 18:02 UTC but the order was already routed. Our bug, not the customer's.

messages.author: Dana (HelpHub)
messages.text: You are right, and I apologise. I will reship today at no cost.

messages.author: Marcus Webb
messages.text: Five weeks now and nothing. I just want the $24 back.

messages.author: Sam (HelpHub)
messages.text: Taking this over from Dana. Refunding order HH-55901 ($24.00) now.

messages.author: Lena Fischer
messages.text: Cancel my annual plan please, I bought it by mistake 5 days ago.

messages.author: Sam (HelpHub)
messages.text: Within 14-day window, so full refund. Customer paid 1,188.00 EUR. Needs finance approval above 1,000.

messages.author: Sam (HelpHub)
messages.text: Hi Lena, I have asked our finance team to approve the full refund. I will confirm tomorrow.

messages.author: Katharina Müller
messages.text: Meine Bestellung HH-30417 ist immer noch nicht in Wien angekommen. Seit 9 Tagen keine Bewegung.

messages.author: Dana (HelpHub)
messages.text: Guten Tag Frau Müller, ich habe eine Nachforschung beim Paketdienst eingeleitet und melde mich bis Freitag.

messages.author: Katharina Müller
messages.text: Danke. Falls es bis nächste Woche nicht da ist, möchte ich das Geld (62,90 €) zurück.

messages.author: Carlos Ibáñez
messages.text: El monitor de mi pedido HH-30991 llegó con la pantalla rota.

messages.author: Tom (HelpHub)
messages.text: Lamentamos lo ocurrido, Carlos. Envíenos una foto y le mandamos un reemplazo sin coste.

messages.author: Carlos Ibáñez
messages.text: Foto adjunta. Prefiero el reembolso de 189,00 EUR.

messages.author: 佐藤 はるか
messages.text: 注文番号 HH-77120 がまだ届きません。予定日は先週でした。

messages.author: Aiko (HelpHub)
messages.text: ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。配送業者に確認し、明日までにご連絡します。

messages.author: Zoë Ångström
messages.text: 😤 my order HH-55102 (£59.00) is STILL ‘in transit’ — 6 days late 🙄

messages.author: Dana (HelpHub)
messages.text: So sorry Zoë 🙏 — I’ve escalated to the carrier and will update you by 17:00.

messages.author: Ines Duarte
messages.text: I ordered HH-81002 (€120.00) and HH-81077 (€45.50) in the same checkout but only the first one arrived.

messages.author: Tom (HelpHub)
messages.text: I can see HH-81077 was split into a separate shipment due to stock. It ships 2025-09-10.

messages.author: Ines Duarte
messages.text: Fine, but I want free express shipping for the delay since I was not told about the split.

messages.author: Tom (HelpHub)
messages.text: Policy allows free express upgrade once per customer. Approved by Sam.
